rule_ref: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011 — Rule 6(1)(a), Rule 10(1)
failure: Name and complete address of the manufacturer not detected on the package.
description: Every package shall bear the name and address of the manufacturer.

failure: Name and address of the packer not detected while the packer differs from the manufacturer.
description: Where the manufacturer is not the packer, name and address of the packer shall be given.

failure: Name and address of the importer not detected on the imported package.
description: For any imported package the name and address of the importer shall be mentioned.

failure: Common or generic name of the commodity not detected on the package.
description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package shall be mentioned.

failure: Net quantity declaration not detected on the package.
description: The net quantity in terms of standard unit of weight or measure, or by number, shall be declared.

failure: Month and year of manufacture / pre-packing / import not detected on the package.
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be mentioned.

failure: Retail sale price (MRP) declaration not detected on the package.
description: The retail sale price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes shall be declared on the package.

failure: Consumer complaint contact / customer care details not detected on the package.
description: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address of the person or office to be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

failure: MRP declaration should read 'MRP Rs ... (incl. of all taxes)' or 'Maximum retail price ... inclusive of all taxes'.
description: The retail sale price declaration must be in the form 'MRP Rs ... incl. of all taxes'.

failure: Net quantity must be expressed in the correct standard unit (grams below 1 kg, millilitres below 1 L) and must not contain misleading words like 'minimum', 'about', 'approximate'.
description: Units of weight/measure and forbidden qualifying expressions in quantity declarations.

failure: Number declarations must not use non-SI terms like 'dozen', 'score', 'gross'.
description: No number called the dozen, score, gross, great gross or the like shall be specified on any package.

failure: Declarations must be legible and prominent and presented in Hindi (Devanagari) or English (other languages may be added).
description: Manner of declaration - legibility, prominence and language of the package label.

rule_ref: Rules, 2011 — Rule 7(2), Rule 7(3), Tables I & II
failure: The height of numerals/letters in declarations on the principal display panel is below the minimum prescribed (Table I / Table II for numerals, 1 mm for letters).
description: Minimum size of numerals and letters in the declarations (Rule 7).

failure: A required declaration was not detected on the principal display panel, or appears truncated at the edge of the visible label.
description: Every declaration shall appear on the principal display panel.

failure: The area around the net quantity declaration is not free from other printed information (space above/below at least one numeral height, and left/right at least twice the numeral height).
description: Area surrounding the quantity declaration shall be free from printed information.

failure: Package is exempt under Rule 26 if net weight/measure is 10 g/10 ml or less.
description: Exemption in respect of certain packages (10 g / 10 ml or less) and fast food packed by restaurants, etc.

failure: Unit Sale Price (USP) not declared or mathematically incorrect according to net quantity.
description: Declaration of Unit Sale Price (USP) for packages containing more than 10 g or 10 ml.
